From d1c44d9afa6f89aa0e10a191f30868eb12cd719f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Heiko Stuebner <heiko@sntech.de>
Date: Tue, 27 Feb 2024 18:35:25 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] arm64: dts: rockchip: add missing interrupt-names for rk356x
 vdpu
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The video-codec@fdea0400 was missing the interrupt-names property that is
part of the binding. Add it.

Fixes: 944be6fba401 ("arm64: dts: rockchip: Add VPU support for RK3568/RK3566")
Cc: Piotr Oniszczuk <piotr.oniszczuk@gmail.com>
Acked-by: Uwe Kleine-König <ukleinek@debian.org>
Signed-off-by: Heiko Stuebner <heiko@sntech.de>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240227173526.710056-1-heiko@sntech.de

diff --git a/arch/arm64/boot/dts/rockchip/rk356x.dtsi b/arch/arm64/boot/dts/rockchip/rk356x.dtsi
index c19c0f1b3778..6a9bfb0550c0 100644
--- a/arch/arm64/boot/dts/rockchip/rk356x.dtsi
+++ b/arch/arm64/boot/dts/rockchip/rk356x.dtsi
@@ -597,6 +597,7 @@ vpu: video-codec@fdea0400 {
 		compatible = "rockchip,rk3568-vpu";
 		reg = <0x0 0xfdea0000 0x0 0x800>;
 		interrupts = <GIC_SPI 139 IRQ_TYPE_LEVEL_HIGH>;
+		interrupt-names = "vdpu";
 		clocks = <&cru ACLK_VPU>, <&cru HCLK_VPU>;
 		clock-names = "aclk", "hclk";
 		iommus = <&vdpu_mmu>;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `arch/arm64/boot/dts/rockchip/rk356x.dtsi`**
   - Added the property `interrupt-names` with the value `"vdpu"` to the `vpu: video-codec@fdea0400` node. This addition specifies the name of the interrupt associated with the video codec, which was previously missing.

### Relationships

- The modification addresses a bug related to the missing `interrupt-names` property in the device tree source (DTS) for the RK356x video processing unit (VPU). This property is part of the device binding requirements, and its absence could lead to issues in handling interrupts correctly for the VPU. The change is a direct fix for a previously introduced feature (VPU support for RK3568/RK3566) that did not fully comply with the expected device tree structure.

arm64: dts: rockchip: add missing interrupt-names for rk356x
 vdpu
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The video-codec@fdea0400 was missing the interrupt-names property that is
part of the binding. Add it.

Fixes: 944be6fba401 ("arm64: dts: rockchip: Add VPU support for RK3568/RK3566")
Cc: Piotr Oniszczuk <piotr.oniszczuk@gmail.com>
Acked-by: Uwe Kleine-König <ukleinek@debian.org>
Signed-off-by: Heiko Stuebner <heiko@sntech.de>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240227173526.710056-1-heiko@sntech.de

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the omission of the `interrupt-names` property in the device tree source for the RK356x video processing unit (VPU). This property is essential for correctly identifying and managing interrupts associated with the VPU, which is part of the device binding requirements. Without it, the system may not handle interrupts properly, leading to potential functionality issues with the video codec.

```plaintext

clocks = <&cru ACLK_VPU>, <&cru HCLK_VPU>;
```
Reason:
The absence of the `interrupt-names` property in the device tree source means that the system cannot properly identify the interrupt associated with the video processing unit (VPU). This omission can lead to improper handling of interrupts, resulting in functionality issues with the video codec.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```plaintext
+		interrupt-names = "vdpu";
```
Reason:
Adding the `interrupt-names` property with the value "vdpu" allows the system to correctly identify and manage the interrupts associated with the VPU. This ensures that the interrupt handling works as intended, aligning with the device binding requirements and preventing potential functionality issues.
